description: Checks whether Little Milwaukee already holds an event, place or business before you research or send it. Works as a plain GET with no sign-in, for example /api/v1/check_duplicate?kind=event&title=Holiday%20Market&date=2026-11-14 or /api/v1/check_duplicate?kind=place&name=Rye%20Lane%20Bakery. Answers duplicate true with the matches and their web addresses, and already_sent true when an unreviewed contribution has this event.

date.description: The event's date as YYYY-MM-DD, for kind event.

name.description: The business or place name, for kind place.

title.description: The event's name, for kind event.

name: check_duplicate
